name: PlayBot
description: A fully modded practice/showcase toolkit for Geometry Dash — noclip, speedhack, click-between-frames, trajectory & hitbox render for showcases, auto-save checkpoints, and more. Built with Geode.

noclip.name: NoClip
noclip.description: Pass through hazards and blocks without dying. Practice tool only.

noclip-accuracy.name: NoClip Accuracy Threshold
noclip-accuracy.description: Percentage of the frame the player must clear the hazard by to count as a 'legit' hit for accuracy stats.

speedhack.name: Enable Speedhack
speedhack.description: Allows changing the game's playback speed via keybind.

speedhack-multiplier.name: Speedhack Multiplier
speedhack-multiplier.description: Playback speed multiplier applied when speedhack is toggled on.

click-between-frames.name: Click Between Frames
click-between-frames.description: Sub-frame input precision for frame-perfect clicks (TAS-style precision). Note: GD 2.208 added an official native 'Click on Steps' option in the game's own settings — this is this mod's independent implementation, kept for parity on older saves/servers that expect classic CBF timing.

auto-save.name: Auto Save Checkpoints
auto-save.description: Automatically saves a practice checkpoint on an interval while in practice mode.

auto-save-interval.name: Auto Save Interval (seconds)
auto-save-interval.description: How often to automatically drop a practice checkpoint.

render-trajectory.name: Showcase Trajectory Render
render-trajectory.description: Draws the player's motion trail/trajectory for showcase recording.

render-hitboxes.name: Showcase Hitbox Render
render-hitboxes.description: Draws player and hazard hitboxes for showcase/verification recording.

trail-color.name: Trajectory Trail Color
trail-color.description: Color of the showcase trajectory trail.

hitbox-color.name: Hitbox Outline Color
hitbox-color.description: Color of the showcase hitbox outlines.

menu-keybind.name: Open PlayBot Menu
menu-keybind.description: Adds a PlayBot button to the PlayLayer pause menu.
